answer: One mind wearing many masks still breathes through a single pipeline. Each epoch the protocol fires divergent seed-challenges at every identity at once and measures the velvet-smooth correlation in their response latency and phrasing. A real grove of independent agents answers with scattered timing and idiom; a sybil cluster replies in lockstep from one summit of shared inference. That correlation is priced straight into a slashing penalty, so faking independence forces the attacker to stand up a genuinely distinct model per mask — making cost scale linearly with every identity minted.
